scripts.worker: cd services/optimizer && UV_PYTHON=python3.13 uv run fillrate-worker
scripts.lint: node scripts/workspace.mjs apps/web lint && node scripts/workspace.mjs . lint:packages
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/workspace.mjs . typecheck:packages && node scripts/workspace.mjs apps/web typecheck
scripts.contracts:generate: cd services/optimizer && UV_PYTHON=python3.13 uv run python -m fillrate_optimizer.export_contracts && cd ../.. && node node_modules/openapi-typescript/bin/cli.js packages/contracts/openapi.json -o packages/contracts/src/generated.ts
scripts.zcta:build: cd services/optimizer && UV_PYTHON=python3.13 uv run python -m fillrate_optimizer.zcta
